note: Extracts the maximum number of arguments from the first byte of fuzzer input, limiting to 15 total args.
Parses NUL-delimited strings from fuzzer input into argv array, including options like --import-cuesheet-from and --add-seekpoint.
Creates a temporary FLAC file path and writes the remaining fuzzer data as the FLAC file content.
Initializes CommandLineOptions with ops.capacity=0 and ops.num_operations=0.
Iterates through command-line arguments, calling parse_option for each recognized option.
Appends an OP__IMPORT_CUESHEET_FROM operation to the operations array for the --import-cuesheet-from argument.
Allocates the initial operations array with capacity 50 when the first operation is appended.
Appends an OP__ADD_SEEKPOINT operation to the operations array for the --add-seekpoint argument.
Finds the OP__IMPORT_CUESHEET_FROM operation in the operations array, obtaining a pointer to it.
Finds the OP__ADD_SEEKPOINT operation in the operations array, obtaining a pointer to it.
If no OP__ADD_SEEKPOINT exists, appends one. This may realloc the operations array, invalidating the op pointer.
Reallocates the operations array when capacity is exceeded, freeing the old memory block and moving operations to a new location.
Writes to op->argument.import_cuesheet_from.add_seekpoint_link using the stale op pointer that points to freed memory after the realloc, causing a heap-use-after-free WRITE.
Later dereferences the dangling add_seekpoint_link pointer when processing the cuesheet import, reading from freed memory.
